name: rhythm_net
task: 30 s single-lead rhythm: N normal / A atrial fibrillation / O other rhythm / ~ too noisy
input: 4500 samples @ 150 Hz (monitoring band-pass, per-window std normalisation) + 16 RR features (ectopy-aware: uses the beat classifier's V/F labels)
intended_use: Research use only. Not validated on clinical monitors.
data: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2017 training set (ODC-By 1.0), REFERENCE-v3 labels, stratified 70/10/20 by record; plus 1677 MIT-BIH windows from records [101, 106, 108, 109, 112, 114, 115, 116, 118, 119, 122, 124, 203, 205, 208, 223, 230]
